title: register-file cell ladder: what one stored bit costs to change
question: Horace Hub Levels tab stop 4 / Q128 section 2: the register file's own cells are unpriced in the 1.946 pJ bottom-up ledger
registered_by: kern-dev (Q129 workflow), on aifoundry1, build and dry run only
card_state: 600 MHz, pinned by et-board-clock-guard; harts 1; board energy above idle
mode: df.un1b.fnot (gen_df.py mode 305), -DENERCAT_DF=ON; the null arm df.un1a.fnot (mode 304)

design.identity: one mode, one .text, across every rung: only the 256 B operand image changes

e_cell_fJ_E61_aifoundry3.note: cross-kernel estimator (family V, A2.3); NOT IDENTIFIED on aifoundry2 and aifoundry1 card 0

P4_null_rfz.rule: abs(slope over rfz rungs) < 0.3 x the rf slope, and flat within 2 SE

decision.estimator: within-pass least squares of board power on cell bits per op over the six rf_ rungs, averaged over passes; two-sided t interval on the between-pass scatter, df = passes - 1; the rail fit reported beside it
decision.rate_gate: a run more than 0.2% from its item's median ops_per_cycle_per_hart is dropped; a rung losing more than one run in a pass voids the pass
decision.null_gate: P4 fails -> e_cell is reported NOT IDENTIFIED by this design and the slope is published as a bound, with the failure named
decision.temperature: preheat 59 C, launch at the first reading <= 58 C, cap 78 C (run_hl.py); three unreachable runs in a row void the pass; the slope is reported with and without a temperature covariate

resolution_stated_in_advance.note: 5 passes separate P1 from 0 and from 3 fJ, and do NOT separate 1.27 from 0.8

waterfall: e_cell x 256 bits of register content per .pi op puts the register file's cell energy near 0.3 pJ per 256-bit op; it enters Q128's unaccounted 3.837 pJ through the 'register-file read ports, operand bus, result path, pipeline registers' line, not through the gate or wire ledger
